Problem Statement:
Given an array, for each element find the value of nearest element to the right which is having frequency greater than as that of current element using 
Stack
. If there does not exist an answer for a position, then make the value '-1'.
Input Description:
First line N indicates the size of the array.
Second line indicates elements of the array
Output Description:
Print the resultant array
Explanation:
Find frequency of the current element and compare it with the frequency of the next right of the current element if it is greater add element to output array and if it is not greater add -1 to the output array.
Sample Input:
7
1 1 2 3 4 2 1
Sample Output:
-1 -1 1 2 2 1 -1
